$comment: AI-02 prompt lock. Every (prompt_id, prompt_version) of the registry is pinned by the SHA-256 of its rendered system prompt and of its output schema (the validator). Editing the prompt text or the schema means a new prompt_version in registry.ts and a new entry here with a change request, an approver and a passing live regression on the task type's test dataset (scripts/ai-regression.mjs), as for a model change (AI-03). authored_by lists who wrote or tuned the prompt: they may not author or check its credibility dataset (CMP-07). Test [AI-02] in services/ai-runtime/test/registry.test.ts enforces it. Version 1 locks the prompts in use since demo v0: nothing to regress against.
